physics-killer-09.title: Iwu mmegharị Newton na tiori mmekọrịta pụrụ iche (Inquiry)
physics-killer-09.topic: Iwu mmegharị Newton na tiori mmekọrịta pụrụ iche (Inquiry)
physics-killer-09.goal: Analyze the principles of Iwu mmegharị Newton na tiori mmekọrịta pụrụ iche (Inquiry) and deduce the correct conclusion under given conditions.
physics-killer-09.material: N'ime mmeghachi omume nuclear fusion $\mathrm{^2H}+\mathrm{^3H}\rightarrow\mathrm{^4He}+\mathrm{n}$, ibu akụkụ ọ bụla bụ $\mathrm{^2H}$: $2.0141\,\mathrm{u}$, $\mathrm{^3H}$: $3.0160\,\mathrm{u}$, $\mathrm{^4He}$: $4.0015\,\mathrm{u}$, neutron: $1.0086\,\mathrm{u}$. A na-eweta ume hà $1\,\mathrm{u}$ dị ka $930\,\mathrm{MeV}$, a na-eleghakwa ume mmegharị nke akụkụ tupu mmeghachi omume anya. Kedu nhọrọ na-ejikọta nke ọma, n'usoro, ume $E$ a wepụtara n'mmeghachi omume a, na ume mmegharị neutron nwere ma ọ bụrụ na e werere na ịdị ukwuu momentum nke $\mathrm{^4He}$ na neutron e mepụtara hà ma ntụnyere ibu ha bụ $4:1$?
physics-killer-09.thinking.0: Iwu mmegharị Newton na tiori mmekọrịta pụrụ iche (Inquiry)
physics-killer-09.s.s1.prompt: N'ime mmeghachi omume nuclear fusion $\mathrm{^2H}+\mathrm{^3H}\rightarrow\mathrm{^4He}+\mathrm{n}$, ibu akụkụ ọ bụla bụ $\mathrm{^2H}$: $2.0141\,\mathrm{u}$, $\mathrm{^3H}$: $3.0160\,\mathrm{u}$, $\mathrm{^4He}$: $4.0015\,\mathrm{u}$, neutron: $1.0086\,\mathrm{u}$. A na-eweta ume hà $1\,\mathrm{u}$ dị ka $930\,\mathrm{MeV}$, a na-eleghakwa ume mmegharị nke akụkụ tupu mmeghachi omume anya. Kedu nhọrọ na-ejikọta nke ọma, n'usoro, ume $E$ a wepụtara n'mmeghachi omume a, na ume mmegharị neutron nwere ma ọ bụrụ na e werere na ịdị ukwuu momentum nke $\mathrm{^4He}$ na neutron e mepụtara hà ma ntụnyere ibu ha bụ $4:1$?
physics-killer-09.s.s1.explain: $\Delta m=5.0301-5.0101=0.0200\,\mathrm{u}$ yabụ $E=\Delta mc^2=0.0200\times930=18.6\,\mathrm{MeV}$. Mgbe mmeghachi omume, ịdị ukwuu momentum nke akụkụ abụọ hà, yabụ $K=\dfrac{p^2}{2m}\propto\dfrac1m$ ma $K_{He}:K_n=1:4$. Ya mere $K_n=\dfrac45\times18.6=14.88\approx14.9\,\mathrm{MeV}$, $K_{He}\approx3.7\,\mathrm{MeV}$.
